testResults.name: historical-view-lookahead-guard
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/data/test_history.py -q
testResults.result: 15 tests passed for bounded per-subscription ring buffers, point-in-time quote/trade/last-N/window/aggregate reads hard-clipped to the engine clock, one-nanosecond LookaheadError rejection, canary no-future-data proof, and benchmark-shaped amortized last-1000 retrieval.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed; the view uses an integer nanosecond timeline, injected clocks only, and no wall-clock, random, network, or I/O access.

decisions: Every query bound is clipped against the clock head; future queries raise LookaheadError instead of leaking data.
HistoricalView.read implements the strategy PointInTimeData boundary and accepts nanosecond timestamps so sub-microsecond engine boundaries remain enforceable.
